provenance.machine: Apple M1 Max, 64 GB, macOS 15, one thread
provenance.source: native kernel throughput ledger (independent drivers through each tool's API; minimum of three runs; uniform random points in the unit square and cube); implicit rows: external implicit comparison (meshing-call CPU of the fastest tool whose sampled distances meet the tolerance in both directions); recovery rows: CGAL CDT_3 on the ledger's icosphere and grid torus surfaces (the generators of this benchmark); refinement rows: Gmsh HXT generate(3) wall time, minimum of three, on the same generated surface given as a discrete surface with MeshSizeMin = MeshSizeMax = the mean surface edge (element counts within 1% of this benchmark's); surface remesh rows: the ledger's surface remeshing table, MMGS library time (MMGS_mmgslib) on the same generated surfaces with -hsiz h -hausd h^2/4

tools.cgal: 6.2.1 Delaunay_triangulation_2/3 range constructor with spatial sort; make_mesh_3 on the implicit function
tools.gmsh: 4.15.2 OpenCASCADE sphere and torus, Delaunay 3D, default optimizer
tools.gmsh-hxt: 4.15.2 Mesh.Algorithm3D=10 with one thread, optimizer off
